70501.commentary: (APAa) vessabhū'ti vessaṃ bhunāti atikkamatī'ti vessabhū. atha vā vesse vāṇijakamme vā kāmarāg'ādike vā kusal'ādikamme vā vatthukāmakilesakāme vā bhunāti abhibhavatī'ti vessabhū, so nāmena vessabhū nāma bhagavā.

examples.text: ito so, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe yaṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi. tasmiññ'eva kho, bhikkhave, ekatiṃse kappe vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke udapādi.
sannipātā tayo āsuṃ, vessabhussa mah'esino, khīṇ'āsavānaṃ vimalānaṃ, santacittāna tādinaṃ.

70502.meaning1: name of one the seven Bharata kings

examples.text: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.

70505.meaning1: name of one of the Four Great Kings
70505.meaning2: name of one of the four great kings

examples.text: atha kho sakko ca devānam'indo vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ purakkhatvā yena vejayanto pāsādo ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu.
seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu, te'pi evam'āhaṃsu, mayam'etaṃ jānāma, mayam'etaṃ passāma. idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti?

70507.meaning1: name of a group of daemons

examples.text: vessāmittā pañcasatā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

70509.meaning1: woman of the third caste of merchants and agriculturalists

examples.text: tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ icchasi kāmesi, jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ khattiyī vā brāhmaṇī vā vessī vā suddī vā'ti? iti puṭṭho no'ti vadeyya.
yā'ti khattiyī vā brāhmaṇī vā vessī vā suddī vā.
kuhiṃ sasīnibhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, kambugīvā kuhiṃ gatā, doḷālolā'va te kaṇṇā, vevaṇṇaṃ samupāgatā.

70516.commentary: (ANa) vevaṇṇiyan'ti vivaṇṇabhāvaṃ. taṃ pan'etaṃ vevaṇṇiyaṃ duvidhaṃ hoti sarīravevaṇṇiyaṃ parikkhāravevaṇṇiyañ'ca. tattha kesamassuoropanena sarīravevaṇṇiyaṃ veditabbaṃ… ayapatte vā mattikapatte vā missak'odano bhuñjitabbo, rukkhamūl'ādisen'āsane muñjatiṇasantharaṇ'ādīsu nipajjitabbaṃ, cammakhaṇḍataṭṭik'ādīsu nisīditabbaṃ, pūtimutt'ādīhi bhesajjaṃ kattabbaṃ hoti. evam'ettha parikkhāravevaṇṇiyaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: vevaṇṇiy'amhi ajjhupagato'ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ

70517.meaning1: wanting to have; wanting to experience; wanting to get; (comm) stinginess
70517.commentary: (NIDD2) vevicchā pamādā nappakāsatī'ti. vevicchaṃ vuccati pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ. yaṃ evarūpaṃ maccheraṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa, idaṃ vuccati macchariyaṃ. api ca khandhamacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ, dhātumacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ, āyatanamacchariyam'pi macchariyaṃ, gāho vuccati macchariyaṃ. (SNPa) vevicchan'ti macchariyaṃ.

examples.text: avijjāya nivuto loko, vevicchā pamādā nappakāsati, japp'ābhilepanaṃ brūmi, dukkham'assa mahabbhayaṃ.
sacco siyā appagabbho, amāyo rittapesuṇo, akkodhano lobhapāpaṃ, vevicchaṃ vitare muni.

70519.meaning1: name of a heavenly realm; name of a class of heavenly beings

70520.meaning1: epithet of a class of devas

70521.meaning1: fact of being a Vehapphala deity

70524.commentary: (DNa) vehāyasā te vanamajjhappattā'ti te ākāsen'eva imaṃ mahāvanaṃ sampattā.

examples.text: ye nāgarāje sahasā haranti, dibbā dijā pakkhi visuddhacakkhū, vehāyasā te vanam'ajjhapattā, citrā supaṇṇā iti tesa nāmaṃ.

viha + āya + sa + aṃ
vehāyasa + aṃ

saṃvijjati kho, bho raṭṭhapāla, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañ'ca vehāsagatañ'ca.

70527.commentary: (VINa) yā hi kāci upari acchinnatalā dvibhūmikā kuṭi tibhūmik'ādikuṭi vā, vehāsakuṭī'ti vuccati. idha pana asīsaghaṭṭā adhippetā.

examples.text: vehāsakuṭi nāma majjhimassa purisassa asīsaghaṭṭā.

70529.meaning1: stored in lofts; kept in attics

bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅ'gamo.

bhūmaṭṭhaṃ thalaṭṭhaṃ ākāsaṭṭhaṃ vehāsaṭṭhaṃ udakaṭṭhaṃ nāvaṭṭhaṃ yānaṭṭhaṃ bhāraṭṭhaṃ ārāmaṭṭhaṃ vihāraṭṭhaṃ khettaṭṭhaṃ vatthuṭṭhaṃ gāmaṭṭhaṃ araññaṭṭhaṃ

viha + āya + sa + ya
vehāsa + ya

70534.meaning1: in the air; in the sky

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā tassa brahmuno upari vehāsaṃ pallaṅkena nisīdi tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā
atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ tap'odaṃ obhāsetvā yena āyasmā samiddhi ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā vehāsaṃ ṭhitā āyasmantaṃ samiddhiṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
phalaṃ ve kadaliṃ hanti, phalaṃ veḷuṃ phalaṃ naḷaṃ, sakkāro kāpurisaṃ hanti, gabbho assatariṃ yathā'ti.
saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.
kuladūsako'ti kulāni dūseti pupphena vā phalena vā cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā dantakaṭṭhena vā veḷuyā vā vejjikāya vā jaṅghapesanikena vā.

70539.commentary: (ANa) veḷukaṇḍakī'ti veḷukaṇṭakanagaravāsinī. tassa kira nagarassa pākāragutt'atthāya pākārapariyantena veḷū ropitā, ten'assa veḷukaṇṭakan'teva nāmaṃ jātaṃ.

examples.text: saddhā bhikkhave upāsikā ekaṃ dhītaraṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya, tādisā, ayye, bhavāhi yādisā khujj'uttarā ca upāsikā veḷukaṇḍakiyā ca nandamātā'ti.

70540.commentary: (ANa) veḷukaṇḍakī'ti veḷukaṇṭakanagaravāsinī. tassa kira nagarassa pākāragutt'atthāya pākārapariyantena veḷū ropitā, ten'assa veḷukaṇṭakan'teva nāmaṃ jātaṃ.

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena veḷukaṇḍakiṃ nandamātaraṃ upāsikaṃ sāriputtamoggallānappamukhe bhikkhusaṅghe chaḷaṅgasamannāgataṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpentiṃ.
ahaṃ kho veḷugumbasmiṃ, bhutvāna madhupāyasaṃ, padakkhiṇaṃ sammasanto, khandhānaṃ udayabbayaṃ, sānuṃ paṭigamissāmi, vivekam'anubrūhayan'ti.
ajā yathā veḷugumbasmiṃ baddhā, avakkhipantī asim'ajjhagacchi, ten'eva tassā galakāvakantaṃ, ayam'pi attho bahutādiso'va.

70543.commentary: (SNa) veḷudvāran'ti gāmadvāre paveṇiāgatassa veḷugacchassa atthitāya evaṃladdhanāmo gāmo.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena veḷudvāraṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.

70544.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: rājā ogadhadīghāvu, sāriputtāpare duve, thapatī veḷudvāreyyā, giñjak'āvasathe tayo'ti.
assosuṃ kho te veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ veḷudvāraṃ anuppatto.

70550.meaning2: relying on bindings; tied with straps

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, jajjarasakaṭaṃ veḷumissakena yāpeti, evam'eva kho, ānanda, vedhamissakena maññe tathāgatassa kāyo yāpeti.

70551.meaning1: cat's eye; lapis lazuli; beryl; semi-precious stone
70551.commentary: (ANa) veḷuriyan'ti maṇī'ti vatvā'pi iminā jātimaṇibhāvaṃ dasseti. ekavassikaveḷuvaṇṇañ'hi veḷuriyaṃ jātimaṇi nāma. taṃ sandhāy'evam'āha. (UDa) veḷuriyo'ti vaṃsavaṇṇa-sirīsapupphavaṇṇ'ādi-saṇṭhānato anekavidho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo bahuratano anekaratano. tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ muttā maṇi veḷuriyo saṅkho silā pavāḷaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ lohit'aṅgo masāragallaṃ

70552.meaning1: made of cat's eye; made of precious stone

examples.text: kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

70553.meaning1: colour of lapis lazuli; deep blue in colour

70554.commentary: (THa) vajjīnaṃ veḷuvagāme'ti vajjiraṭṭhassa veḷuvagāme, vajjiraṭṭhe yattha pacchimavassaṃ upagacchi veḷuvagāme.

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando vesāliyaṃ viharati veḷuvagāmake. tena kho pana samayena dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro pāṭaliputtaṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

70556.meaning1: entering the rains retreat at Veḷuva village

atha kho te attano antevāsikehi aḍḍhateyyehi paribbājakasatehi saddhiṃ veḷuvanaṃ agamaṃsu.

70560.commentary: (MNa) vo'ti ayaṃ vo-saddo paccatta-upayoga-karaṇa-sampadāna-sāmivacana-padapūraṇesu dissati… gacchatha, bhikkhave, paṇāmemi vo'ti-ādīsu (ma. ni. 2.157) upayoge.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi, sati uttariṃ karaṇīye.

70561.meaning1: by you all; with you all

tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma. evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.
kāya nu'ttha, licchavī, eta'r'ahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā'ti
kassa nu kho, bhante, subhāsitan'ti? sabbesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane metteyyapañhe

70564.grammar: pron, 2nd gen pl, gen abs of tvaṃ

anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?

seyyathā'pi, āvuso yamaka, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, so ca ārakkhasampanno. tassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya anatthakāmo ahitakāmo ayogakkhemakāmo jīvitā voropetu'kāmo.

70573.meaning1: with a mixture of ease and discomfort; with a combination of pleasure and pain; mingled with happiness and sorrow

examples.text: so sabyābajjhehi'pi abyābajjhehi'pi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjham'pi abyābajjham'pi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ, seyyathā'pi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.

70577.meaning1: deviates; diverges; goes astray; veers off course (from)

examples.text: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.

70578.meaning1: stepping aside; moving out of the way (of)

examples.text: seṭṭhi gahapati rathena paṭipathaṃ āgacchanto taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca, apeh'āyye'ti. sā vokkamantī tatth'eva paripati. seṭṭhi gahapati taṃ bhikkhuniṃ khamāpesi, khamāh'āyye, may'āsi pātitā'ti.

70580.meaning2: having turned aside, having deviated from

70581.commentary: (DNa) okkamitvā vokkamissathā'ti paṭisandhivasena okkamitvā cutivasena vokkamissatha, nirujjhissathā'ti attho. so pan'assa nirodho na tass'eva cittassa nirodhena, na tato dutiyatatiyānaṃ nirodhena hoti. paṭisandhicittena hi saddhiṃ samuṭṭhitāni samatiṃsa kammajarūpāni nibbattanti. tesu pana ṭhitesu'y'eva soḷasa bhav'aṅgacittāni uppajjitvā nirujjhanti. etasmiṃ antare gahitapaṭisandhikassa dārakassa vā mātuyā vā pan'assa antarāyo n'atthi. (DNt) vokkamissathā'ti santativicchedaṃ vināsaṃ upagamissatha, taṃ pana maraṇaṃ nāma hotī'ti āha cutivasenā'ti.

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, mātukucchismiṃ okkamitvā vokkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ itthattāya abhinibbattissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

70582.meaning1: turning aside; deviating; diverging; straying; veering away (from)
70582.meaning2: having turned aside, having deviated from

examples.text: tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā.

70584.meaning1: the basis is completely severed; the support is completely cut off

examples.text: rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti. tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ.

70585.grammar: pr, pass of vi ud √chid, intrans
70585.meaning1: is completely cut off; is totally severed

examples.text: rūpadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti. rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.

70588.meaning1: would have been completely cut off; would have been severed
70588.meaning2: would have been completely cut off; would have been severed

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, daharass'eva sato vocchijjissatha kumārakassa vā kumārikāya vā, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

70591.notes: (PED) a momentary stage in the unit called percept

examples.text: diṭṭhamattaṃ nāma tatth'eva uppannaṃ sampaṭicchana-santīraṇa-voṭṭhabbana-saṅkhātaṃ cittattayaṃ.

yato naṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, ye vītimissā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, na te tathāgatassa saṃvijjantī'ti, tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā'ti?

tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ, dīgharattam'idaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ rāgena dosena mohenā'ti. cittasaṃkilesā, bhikkhave, sattā saṃkilissanti. cittavodānā sattā visujjhanti.
puna caparaṃ, sāriputta, tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
